title: Engineering Foundations
tagline: The base every senior engineer stands on: Python, CS, Linux, Git, networking, algorithms.

topics.title: Python mastery
topics.summary: Production-grade Python, not scripts. You will write most agent and ML code in it.
items: Data model: dunder methods, descriptors, properties, __slots__
Iterators, generators, yield from, itertools, functools
Decorators, closures, context managers (contextlib)
Type hints: generics, Protocol, TypedDict, ParamSpec, mypy/pyright
Dataclasses and Pydantic v2 (validation, serialization, settings)
asyncio: event loop, tasks, gather, semaphores, cancellation, timeouts
Threading vs multiprocessing vs asyncio; the GIL and free-threaded Python
Memory model: refcounting, GC, weakrefs, profiling with tracemalloc
Packaging: pyproject.toml, uv/poetry, venvs, lockfiles, wheels
Testing: pytest fixtures, parametrize, mocking, property-based (hypothesis)
Profiling and performance: cProfile, py-spy, vectorization, Cython/Numba/Rust extensions
Logging, structured logs, exceptions design, retries (tenacity)
questions: Explain the GIL. When does multithreading still help in Python?
How does asyncio differ from threads? When does it hurt you?
What happens when a generator is garbage-collected mid-iteration?
How do you design a retry policy that does not cause a retry storm?
resources: Python docs: asyncio and data model

topics.title: Computer science core
topics.summary: Operating systems, memory, concurrency and compilers at the level needed to reason about performance.
items: Processes, threads, scheduling, context switches
Virtual memory, paging, page cache, mmap, NUMA basics
Concurrency: locks, atomics, deadlocks, race conditions, memory ordering
File systems, I/O models: blocking, non-blocking, epoll, io_uring
CPU caches, branch prediction, SIMD, why memory bandwidth dominates ML
Compilation, interpreters, JIT, bytecode
Serialization formats: JSON, Protobuf, Avro, Arrow, Parquet, MessagePack
Unicode, tokenization-adjacent text encoding, UTF-8 pitfalls
questions: What is the difference between a process and a thread, and what does a context switch cost?
Why is GPU inference usually memory-bandwidth bound rather than compute bound?
Explain how epoll lets one thread serve thousands of connections.

topics.title: Linux and shell
topics.summary: You will debug production boxes and containers. Be fast at the terminal.
items: Filesystem layout, permissions, users, groups, sudo
Process management: ps, top/htop, kill, signals, systemd units
Text tooling: grep, sed, awk, jq, xargs, find, ripgrep
Networking tools: curl, dig, ss/netstat, tcpdump, nc, traceroute
Bash scripting: set -euo pipefail, functions, traps, here-docs
SSH, tunnels, key management, ssh-agent, bastion hosts
Resource debugging: strace, lsof, perf, vmstat, iostat, nvidia-smi
cgroups and namespaces: what a container actually is
questions: A service is slow. Walk me through diagnosing it on a Linux host.
What is a zombie process and how do you get rid of it?
How do cgroups limit container memory and what happens at the limit (OOM killer)?

topics.title: Git and collaboration
topics.summary: Version control, code review and trunk-based delivery.
items: Branching strategies: trunk-based vs gitflow
Rebase vs merge, interactive rebase, bisect, reflog, cherry-pick
Monorepo vs polyrepo trade-offs
Code review practice, PR size, CODEOWNERS
Conventional commits, semantic versioning, changelogs
Git hooks, pre-commit, secret scanning
questions: How would you find the commit that introduced a regression?
Trunk-based development vs long-lived branches: when does each win?

topics.title: Networking and the web
topics.summary: Every agent call is a network call. Know what happens on the wire.
items: OSI/TCP-IP model, IP, subnets, CIDR, NAT
TCP: handshake, congestion control, slow start, TIME_WAIT, keepalive
UDP and QUIC / HTTP/3
DNS resolution, caching, TTL, GeoDNS
HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3, headers, caching, idempotency
TLS 1.3 handshake, certificates, mTLS, SNI
REST, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSockets, SSE (why LLM streaming uses SSE)
Proxies, reverse proxies, load balancers L4 vs L7, CDNs
Auth on the wire: cookies, JWT, OAuth2/OIDC flows, API keys
questions: What happens when you type a URL and hit enter, in detail?
SSE vs WebSockets for streaming LLM tokens: trade-offs?
Why does HTTP/2 help with many small requests and where does it still fall short?

topics.title: Data structures and algorithms
topics.summary: Still asked in many senior loops. Keep it sharp, not obsessive.
items: Complexity analysis, amortized analysis
Arrays, hash maps, sets, heaps, deques, tries
Trees: BST, balanced trees, segment tree, Fenwick
Graphs: BFS, DFS, topological sort, Dijkstra, union-find, MST
Dynamic programming patterns
Binary search on answer, two pointers, sliding window, monotonic stack
Sorting, selection, top-k, streaming algorithms
Probabilistic structures: Bloom filter, HyperLogLog, count-min sketch, LSH
Approximate nearest neighbor ideas: HNSW graph, IVF, product quantization (conceptually)
questions: Design an LRU cache with O(1) operations.
Find top-k frequent items in a stream with bounded memory.
How does HNSW search work at a high level?

topics.title: Software craftsmanship
topics.summary: What separates senior from mid: design judgement, testing discipline, maintainability.
items: SOLID, composition over inheritance, dependency injection
Design patterns that matter: strategy, adapter, observer, state machine, repository
Clean architecture / hexagonal architecture
Test pyramid, contract tests, snapshot tests, mutation testing
API design: versioning, pagination, error models, idempotency keys
Refactoring safely, feature flags, expand/contract migrations
Technical writing: design docs, ADRs, runbooks
Reading large codebases and debugging unfamiliar systems
questions: How do you test code that calls a non-deterministic LLM?
How do you roll out a breaking API change with zero downtime?
